caption: A left hand grips the black knob of a transparent glass lid resting on a white-speckled black pot set on a foil-lined stovetop beside a granite counter. Through the steam-fogged glass a pale, foamy liquid churns beneath. The hand holds the knob steady, then lifts the lid upward and toward the left, tilting it so the rim clears the pot's edge. As the lid swings out of frame, motion blur streaks its glass surface and the open pot is exposed. With the cover gone, the white liquid continues to simmer, its frothy surface undulating and bubbling around a grainy patch at the center. Both black handles now sit within the frame, flanking the simmering contents. The foil backdrop and stove grates remain largely in place, with only slight framing drift. The foam rises and settles in slow, irregular waves across the surface. The uncovered pot keeps boiling steadily while the lid stays out of view.
relations: Hand gripping the knob holds the lid seated on the pot rim.
Steam fogging the glass indicates liquid simmering beneath the cover.
Lifting the lid away exposes the churning, foamy surface.
Once uncovered, the liquid continues bubbling around the central grainy patch.
